verdict.rationale: Data portability applies to a SaaS video platform, but the evidence never documents a bulk account or data export feature, nor any way to take avatars, voice clones, scripts, and assets out in open formats. The '4K video export' and 'SCORM export' items are adjacent features for delivering rendered videos and LMS packages, not account-wide data portability. The profile/credit retrieval endpoint is a developer building block, not an export capability, so neither earns credit.
